compareMetricEpsDilutedDefinition: Earnings per share (diluted). Net income divided by weighted average shares outstanding.
compareMetricEpsDilutedTooltip: Earnings per share (diluted). Net income divided by shares outstanding.
compareMetricEpsDilutedWhyMatters: Directly comparable across companies. Essential for P/E valuation.
compareMetricFreeCashFlowDefinition: Cash from operations minus capital expenditures. Shows cash generation ability.
compareMetricFreeCashFlowTooltip: Cash from operations minus capital expenditures. Shows cash generation ability.
compareMetricFreeCashFlowWhyMatters: Cash available for dividends, buybacks, and debt reduction. Key indicator of financial flexibility.
compareMetricGrossMarginDefinition: Revenue minus cost of goods sold, divided by revenue.
compareMetricGrossMarginTooltip: Gross profit divided by revenue. Measures profitability after direct costs.
compareMetricGrossMarginWhyMatters: Higher gross margins indicate pricing power or cost efficiency. Sustained low margins can signal commoditization.
compareMetricNetIncomeDefinition: Profit after all expenses, interest, and taxes.
compareMetricNetIncomeTooltip: Profit after all expenses and taxes.
compareMetricNetIncomeWhyMatters: Bottom-line profit drives dividends and buybacks. Essential for valuation.
compareMetricNetMarginDefinition: Net income divided by revenue. Reflects bottom-line profitability after all expenses.
compareMetricNetMarginTooltip: Net income divided by revenue. Reflects overall profitability.
compareMetricNetMarginWhyMatters: Reflects overall profitability. Higher margins typically indicate a stronger competitive moat.
compareMetricOperatingMarginDefinition: Operating income (revenue minus operating expenses) divided by revenue.
compareMetricOperatingMarginTooltip: Operating income divided by revenue. Indicates operational profitability.
compareMetricOperatingMarginWhyMatters: Indicates operational profitability before interest and taxes. Shows how well management controls costs.
compareMetricRevenueDefinition: Total revenue from operations. Primary measure of business scale and top-line performance.
compareMetricRevenueGrowthDefinition: Year-over-year percentage change in revenue. Compares latest fiscal year to prior year.
compareMetricRevenueGrowthTooltip: Year-over-year revenue change. Indicates top-line growth trend.
compareMetricRevenueGrowthWhyMatters: Sustained growth suggests market share gains or expansion. Compare to industry averages.
compareMetricRevenueTooltip: Total revenue from operations. Primary measure of business scale.
compareMetricRevenueWhyMatters: Scale matters for bargaining power, R&D investment, and economies of scale.
compareMetricShareholdersEquityDefinitio: Shareholders' ownership value. Assets minus liabilities.
compareMetricShareholdersEquityTooltip: Shareholders' ownership value. Assets minus liabilities.
compareMetricShareholdersEquityWhyMatter: Book value of equity. Important for value investors and financial health.
compareMetricTotalAssetsDefinition: Total value of company assets (current and non-current). Indicates balance sheet size.
compareMetricTotalAssetsTooltip: Total value of company assets. Indicates balance sheet size.
compareMetricTotalAssetsWhyMatters: Larger asset bases can support growth but also imply greater capital intensity.
